examples.en: Rebuilding the whole widget tree for a keystroke is a rookie mistake.
examples.zh: 每次击键都重建整棵组件树是新手错误。

situation.en: In Flutter everything is the widget tree; state placement decides what rebuilds.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 组件树（Flutter/UI 的层级结构）

examples.en: Rebuild a widget when its inputs change, not on a timer.
examples.zh: 在输入变化时重建组件，而不是靠定时器。

situation.en: If a timer makes you rebuild a widget every second, the design is wrong.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 重建组件（触发 UI 刷新）

examples.en: Hot reload keeps the state while swapping the layout.
examples.zh: 热重载在替换布局的同时保留状态。

situation.en: Hot reload spoils you; web refresh cycles feel slow forever after.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 热重载（不重启改界面）

examples.en: A hot restart clears state but skips the full install.
examples.zh: 热重启会清掉状态，但省去了完整安装。

situation.en: When hot reload leaves ghosts, do a hot restart before blaming the code.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 热重启（重置状态的完整重启）

examples.en: A platform channel carries calls from Dart into native code.
examples.zh: 平台通道把调用从 Dart 送进原生代码。

situation.en: We use a platform channel for the payment SDK that has no Flutter plugin.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 平台通道（跨端调原生能力的桥）

examples.en: The native module wraps the scanner hardware behind a simple API.
examples.zh: 原生模块把扫码硬件包在一个简单的接口后面。

situation.en: I wrote the native module in Kotlin and bridged it to the Flutter side.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 原生模块

examples.en: The JavaScript bridge lets the web page ask the app for the camera.
examples.zh: JS 桥让网页能向应用申请调用相机。

situation.en: Every JavaScript bridge method is an API contract; version it like one.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: JS 桥（网页与原生互相调用的通道）

examples.en: A deep link should land on content, not on the home tab.
examples.zh: 深度链接应该落在内容上，而不是首页标签。

situation.en: Marketing campaigns arrive through a deep link with attribution parameters.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 深度链接（直接打开应用内某页的链接）

examples.en: A universal link opens the app when installed and the site when not.
examples.zh: 通用链接在装了应用时打开应用，没装时打开网站。

situation.en: Universal links need the association file hosted exactly right, or they silently fall back.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 通用链接（iOS 的官方深链方案）

examples.en: Ask for notification permission after value, not at first launch.
examples.zh: 要在用户感受到价值之后、而不是首次启动时，就申请通知权限。

situation.en: Notification permission rates double when the ask follows a completed task.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 通知权限

examples.en: The app lifecycle decides when you may sync and when you must stop.
examples.zh: 应用生命周期决定你什么时候能同步、什么时候必须停。

situation.en: Most upload bugs are app lifecycle bugs: the OS killed us mid-transfer.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 应用生命周期（前台、后台、挂起等状态）

examples.en: Background fetch is a privilege the OS grants unpredictably.
examples.zh: 后台拉取是系统不定期赐予的特权。

situation.en: Design background fetch as a bonus, never as a guarantee.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 后台拉取（应用在后台偷偷更新数据）

examples.en: The review guidelines ban the payment flow our first design used.
examples.zh: 审核指南禁止了我们第一版设计用的支付流程。

situation.en: Reading the review guidelines before designing payments saved us a rejection.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 审核指南（应用商店的规则）

examples.en: An in-app purchase must restore on a new device from the same account.
examples.zh: 应用内购买必须能在同账号的新设备上恢复。

situation.en: Server-side receipt validation is what makes an in-app purchase trustworthy.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 应用内购买

examples.en: Sandbox testing uses fake accounts so no real money moves.
examples.zh: 沙盒测试用假账号，这样就不会动到真钱。

situation.en: Run the whole purchase matrix in sandbox testing before the review build.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 沙盒测试（在测试环境验证购买等流程）

examples.en: An expired provisioning profile fails the build at the worst moment.
examples.zh: 过期的描述文件总在最糟糕的时刻让构建失败。

situation.en: The provisioning profile ties the app, the certificate, and the devices together.
situation.zh: 你向新人解释 iOS 发布流程，这样说：

entries.zh: 描述文件（iOS 的签名授权文件）

examples.en: Lose the keystore and you lose the ability to update your own app.
examples.zh: 丢了密钥库，你就失去了更新自己应用的能力。

situation.en: We keep the keystore backed up in two places; it outlives every laptop.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 密钥库（安卓的签名密钥文件）

examples.en: Test the release build, not just debug: optimizers change behavior.
examples.zh: 要测正式构建，不能只测调试版：优化器会改变行为。

situation.en: The crash existed only in the release build, thanks to tree shaking.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 正式构建（发布用的优化包）

examples.en: A debug build trades speed for observability.
examples.zh: 调试构建用速度换可观测性。

situation.en: Never profile performance on a debug build; the numbers lie politely.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 调试构建

examples.en: The app bundle lets the store ship each device only its slices.
examples.zh: 应用包让商店只给每台设备发它需要的那几片。

situation.en: Switching to the app bundle cut our download size by a third.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 应用包（按设备拆分的发布格式）

examples.en: An APK split per architecture keeps each download small.
examples.zh: 按架构做 APK 拆分能让每个下载包保持小巧。

situation.en: With an APK split for densities, the images stop doubling the size.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: APK 拆分（按架构/密度出多个包）

examples.en: The app size budget is fifty megabytes; every SDK argues with it.
examples.zh: 应用体积预算是五十兆；每个 SDK 都要跟它吵一架。

situation.en: We review the app size budget at every release; SDK creep is silent.
situation.zh: 你在发版评审时这样说：

entries.zh: 应用体积预算

examples.en: A cold start pays for every plugin your app registers.
examples.zh: 冷启动要为应用注册的每个插件买单。

situation.en: Cold start over two seconds shows up in retention within a month.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 冷启动（进程从零拉起）

examples.en: A splash screen that waits for the network teaches users to hate it.
examples.zh: 一个要等网络的启动屏会教会用户讨厌它。

situation.en: Our splash screen shows cached content the moment local data is ready.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 启动屏、闪屏

examples.en: Tokens belong in secure storage, not in plain preferences.
examples.zh: 令牌应该放在安全存储里，而不是普通的偏好设置里。

situation.en: Secure storage wraps the platform keychain and keystore for us.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 安全存储（系统钥匙串里的存储）

examples.en: Biometric unlock is convenience layered over the real credential.
examples.zh: 生物识别解锁是盖在真实凭据之上的便利层。

situation.en: Biometric unlock fails closed: three misses and the PIN returns.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 生物识别解锁（指纹/面容）

examples.en: A permission request without a reason reads as suspicion.
examples.zh: 一个不带理由的权限申请读起来就像在招人怀疑。

situation.en: We explain before the permission request, in our own UI, in one sentence.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 权限申请

examples.en: A runtime permission can be revoked while your feature is running.
examples.zh: 运行时权限可以在你的功能正运行时被撤销。

situation.en: Design every feature to survive a runtime permission disappearing mid-flow.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 运行时权限（用到时才申请的那种）

examples.en: A mini program lives inside a host app and plays by its rules.
examples.zh: 小程序活在一个宿主应用里面，按它的规矩行事。

situation.en: I shipped a merchant mini program on Alipay that reached a hundred thousand merchants.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 小程序

examples.en: Subpackage loading keeps the first screen fast and the rest lazy.
examples.zh: 分包加载让首屏快、其余部分懒加载。

situation.en: With subpackage loading, the reports module downloads only when opened.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 分包加载（小程序按需下代码包）

examples.en: The package size limit forced us to move charts to on-demand loading.
examples.zh: 包体积限制逼我们把图表改成按需加载。

situation.en: Every platform has a package size limit; design the split on day one.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 包体积限制（平台对代码包的硬上限）

examples.en: A hybrid app trades native feel for one shared codebase.
examples.zh: 混合应用用原生手感换一套共享代码库。

situation.en: Our internal tools are a hybrid app: the shell is native, the screens are web.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 混合应用（原生壳 + 网页内容）

examples.en: The webview container handles login and payment; pages handle content.
examples.zh: WebView 容器管登录和支付；页面管内容。

situation.en: Keep the webview container thin, or you rebuild the browser badly.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: WebView 容器（装网页的原生外壳）

examples.en: Design in logical pixels; pixel density is the runtime's problem.
examples.zh: 用逻辑像素做设计；像素密度是运行时的事。

situation.en: Icons ship at three pixel densities or they blur on flagship phones.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 像素密度

examples.en: Buttons must live inside the safe area on every device shape.
examples.zh: 按钮必须落在每种机型的安全区里面。

situation.en: The checkout button hid under the gesture bar until we respected the safe area.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 安全区（避开刘海和手势条的区域）

examples.en: The notch eats the title unless the layout insets for it.
examples.zh: 刘海会吃掉标题，除非布局为它让出内边距。

situation.en: Test on a device with a notch and one without; both lie differently.
situation.zh: 你向同事解释这个概念时这样讲：

entries.zh: 刘海（屏幕顶部的挖孔/凹口）

examples.en: Gesture handling decides whether a swipe feels like butter or sandpaper.
examples.zh: 手势处理决定滑动的手感是黄油还是砂纸。

situation.en: Our drawer conflicted with the system back gesture until we fixed gesture handling.
situation.zh: 面试官问你的移动端经验，你回答：

entries.zh: 手势处理

examples.en: List virtualization keeps a ten-thousand-row feed at sixty frames.
examples.zh: 列表虚拟化能让一万行的信息流保持六十帧。

situation.en: On mobile, list virtualization is the difference between smooth and uninstalled.
situation.zh: 你在评审移动端方案时这样说：

entries.zh: 列表虚拟化（移动端长列表只渲染可见项）
